text:
jordan_sales: Quick one — prospect (Quicksilver Bank) wants BYO-KMS + HSM proxy in their VPC for our Dedicated offering. They've pushed back on two things: (1) rotation window must be < 5min, (2) billing wants an explicit per-request surcharge. Need quick answers so I can update the SOW.

marta_se: Thanks — can you drop their expected QPS and max seq length? rotation <5m is tight depending on proxy cache and TLS handshakes.

jordan_sales: They mentioned peaky auth traffic: ~200 rps burst, baseline ~30 rps. Seq len for gpt-ish requests ~512 tokens.

leo_eng: For 200 rps bursts with 512 token sequences, two things matter: KV cache hit rate and TLS session reuse. If the HSM call is needed per-request (unwrapped request), latency per call ~150-300ms depending on region. With prefix caching and a session pool we can amortize; aim for 95th < 120ms but need to measure.

sam_sre: Network-wise we'll need a dedicated NAT from their VPC to our HSM proxy cluster or a private peering. Firewall rules: allow outbound 443 to proxy IPs, ephemeral ports 1024-65535 for responses. Also need to whitelist our SRE runbooks for failover.

priya_security: From security checklist: we need their KMS attestation doc + HSM tamper-evidence report. Also confirm whether they require FIPS 140-2 Level 3. If so there are additional onboarding steps and longer lead time. Link to questionnaire: https://redwood.internal/sec/kms-questionnaire (internal).

finn_finance: On pricing: we can do a per-request surcharge but prefer a blended model with reserved baseline + overage. If they insist on per-request, what surcharge are they asking? and is it just HSM ops or network egress too?

jordan_sales: They proposed $0.02 per HSM call and want it visible on invoice line items.

marta_se: $0.02/call seems high for high-volume bursts; engineering needs to validate cost. We can propose a tiered surcharge: $0.03/call for <100k/mo, $0.015 for >1M/mo. Also offer a Dedicated-capacity commit to reduce surcharge.

leo_eng: For the rotation ask (<5m) need to clarify what they mean: (A) key roll active with new requests within 5m, or (B) CRLs/old keys fully revoked across all nodes within 5m? If (B) that requires propagation to all caches and likely won't hold at global scale without brief degraded availability.

jordan_sales: They mean (A) — new keys in use <5m after rotation.

leo_eng: OK then that's doable if we trigger rotation in off-peak and use a staged rollout: update KMS, push new wrapping keys to HSM proxy keycache, start accepting new tokens. We should document the flow and TTLs. I'll sketch a runbook.

sam_sre: Runbook quick checklist: 1) trigger rotation in KMS API 2) warm proxy cache with new wrapping key 3) notify canary region 4) cut traffic in canary 5) global rollout 6) monitor error rate + fallback to previous key for 10m. Need a canary window — recommend 60s.

priya_security: Add to runbook: audit log entries for rotation event, signed S3 archive of key material handshake (if customer requests evidence), and retention policy for rotation artifacts. Also need to confirm whether customer requires HSM-backed key-import ceremony.

finn_finance: For billing visibility it's fine to surface per-call lines. We'll need to add a SKU. Ops: is there a distinct product code for HSM-proxied requests vs normal Redwood API calls?

ops-bot: Deployment note: There is an open PR #4821 that adds per-call metering tags for BYO-KMS paths. ETA for rollout to staging: 3 days.

marta_se: Next steps: (1) Leo -> runbook + latency estimate matrix for 30/200/500 rps (2) Sam -> networking checklist + peering options (3) Priya -> list of docs we need from customer (4) Finn -> draft tiered surcharge options + sample invoice layout. Jordan pls set up a 15m sync with customer after we have initial numbers.

jordan_sales: Thanks everyone — aiming to update Quicksilver by EOD tomorrow. Also cc'ing legal for SOW language once we have price + rotation SLAs. :thumbsup:

leo_eng: I'll post the latency matrix here when ready. Expect initial numbers in ~24h.

priya_security: I'll DM Jordan the exact doc checklist (PII handling + attestation samples).

sam_sre: Adding network templates below — use these as starting point:```tf
resource "aws_vpc_peering_connection" "peer" {
  vpc_id = "${var.customer_vpc}"
  peer_vpc_id = "${var.redwood_vpc}"
}
```

jordan_sales: Great. If anyone hits blockers ping me.

finn_finance: One last ask — can legal sign off on the visible per-request line before we promise the invoice format?

marta_se: I'll loop in solutions-legal.

ops-bot: Thread archived to sales/ops checklist after 7d of inactivity.
